{{Top|leg}}
'''Transponder beacons''' or '''marker transponders'''<ref name="TTDJ">{{JournalCite|10|Toria Tell's Droid Journal (article)}}</ref> were devices used by [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] to mark their findings so they could later come back for them. Each transponder beacon was set to a unique frequency.

[[Fahs Oxsor]] knew a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] suffering from [[Bitter Winter]] who stabbed himself around forty times because he believed that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] has impregnated him with thousands of tiny transponder beacons.<ref name="BW">{{JournalCite|5|A Bitter Winter}}</ref>
